items.topic: CRITICAL PATH — What is the core idea?
items.context: This is the #1 blocker. Rounds 1-5 generated 17 decisions, but none can be resolved until we know what this idea actually is. This consolidates round 1 d1 (core idea) with round 5 d1 (inspiration). Please answer this question — even a single sentence — to unblock all downstream planning.

options.label: A new testing framework or tool for Vrooli scenarios
options.rationale: Builds on existing test-genie and scenario test infrastructure to provide better testing capabilities across the platform

options.label: A new scenario (product/service) that is test-related
options.rationale: A standalone scenario providing testing as a service — e.g., API testing, load testing, or regression testing as a monetizable product

options.label: An improvement to the existing test-genie scenario
options.rationale: Rather than building something new, enhance the existing AI-assisted test generation tool

options.label: Something not related to testing at all
options.rationale: The name 'new test idea' is misleading — describe the actual idea in freeform

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe the idea in your own words using freeform. Even one sentence will unblock planning.

items.topic: CRITICAL PATH — What problem does this solve?
items.context: This is the #2 blocker (consolidates round 1 d3). Without a problem statement, we cannot define scope, acceptance criteria, or success metrics. What pain point, gap, or opportunity motivates this idea?

options.label: Existing tests are too slow or unreliable
options.rationale: Focus on speed, flakiness reduction, or parallelization

options.label: Test coverage is insufficient or hard to measure
options.rationale: Focus on coverage analysis, gap detection, and reporting

options.label: Writing tests is too manual or time-consuming
options.rationale: Focus on test generation, scaffolding, and AI-assisted authoring

options.label: No existing solution for a specific type of testing
options.rationale: Fill a gap — e.g., integration testing across scenarios, contract testing, E2E testing

options.label: Not a testing problem — different domain entirely
options.rationale: Describe the actual problem in freeform

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe the problem in your own words

items.topic: CRITICAL PATH — Which scenario does this target?
items.context: This is the #3 blocker (consolidates round 2 d1). The spec.json has no scope field. Knowing the target enables sandbox scoping, acceptance criteria, and technical context for the plan.

options.label: New standalone scenario (scenarios/new-test-idea/)
options.rationale: Greenfield — new scenario directory with its own API, possible UI, and service.json

options.label: Extend test-genie (scenarios/test-genie/)
options.rationale: Enhance the existing AI-assisted test generation scenario

options.label: Extend agent-manager (scenarios/agent-manager/)
options.rationale: Add capabilities within the agent-manager infrastructure

options.label: Cross-cutting infrastructure (no single scenario)
options.rationale: Work spans multiple scenarios or lives in shared infrastructure

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify the target scenario or directory

items.text: CONSOLIDATION ROUND: Rounds 1-5 generated 17 decisions covering concept, audience, problem, deployment, priority, scope, acceptance, resources, integration, MVP, metrics, monetization, UI, security, test-genie relationship, inspiration, and effort. All remain unresolved. This round distills the 3 decisions that gate ALL downstream planning. Answering just these 3 (even briefly) will unblock plan population for Purpose, Problem Statement, Scope, Target End State, and Implementation Strategy.

Once these 3 critical-path decisions are answered, most of the 14 remaining decisions from rounds 1-5 can either be inferred from context or addressed in a focused follow-up round. The plan.md will be substantially populated after these answers.

plan_updates: Updated plan.md: revised Implementation Strategy TBD to reflect 17 unresolved decisions and the 3 critical-path blockers. Updated Risks + Mitigations to reference round 6 consolidation. Updated decision-paralysis mitigation to emphasize the 3-decision minimum.
